transcript: My mother slapped me three times, four times. For what? Oh, for multiple things. I was a troublemaker in my school and class. And I failed in my 10th. And I really feel I let her down. So, I told my mom, I said, mom, get me out of the school, because it is embarrassing for me to sit with the juniors. I'll be the only person sitting with the same class. And I realized my mistake. My mother said to me, you messed up, you pay for it. I am not going to bail you out. I will not bail you out. You messed up, you pay for it. I said, mom, they'll be happy to give me a pass certificate, so I can go to some other school, and I'll save one year of my life. Now, hear this, Ishan. My mother said, I would rather see you lose one year of your life than lose your values for the rest of your life. I would rather see you lose one year of your life than lose your values for the rest of your life. What a message. Did not bail me out. And I'm glad she did not.
caption:
Such an important lesson.

Got a chance to interview the legendary motivational author and public speaker Shiv Khera in Delhi last month.
